notes: Names printed without suffix (RAVINE, RENNER, BYRON, MOHAWK, VERNON, CONROY, LINN, BANK) written with 'Street'. Crossings on the boundary streets of this sheet are picked here even though they also appear on already-picked neighbours (same names): the Conroy Street row at the top (Ravine, Renner, Sohn x2, Vernon x2; also on 239), Klotter/Ravine (also 227, 238, 239), Mohawk/Ravine, Ravine/McMicken and the two Byron/McMicken T's (also 227), and Linn/Central, Brown Alley/Linn, the two Linn/Bank T's and Central/Bank (also 227, 217). Byron Street (30') is one straight SW-NE street from the Miami Canal bank to Renner (house numbers 2100-2125 NE of McMicken); it jogs ~140 px at McMicken, so the unnamed '?' street on sheet 227 at (6067,2906) is the NE part of Byron Street. Renner Street runs N-S (centre x~3407) from Conroy (where it continues onto 239 as RENNER), bends SE at y~1145 (33' NW of Byron, 30' SE of it) and runs off ESE onto 229. The N-S street at x~5535 with WOODEN STEPS along its west side (20') is Vernon Street (labelled VERNON on 239 just north of Conroy and on this sheet near Mohawk); it bends SSW at y~1880, crosses Renner and Mohawk and ends at McMicken. Sohn Street (20', printed SOHN ST.) runs south from Conroy; south of y~940 its east line is dashed (not open) down to Renner, so the Sohn/Renner T is on the not-open part. Eichelmann Alley (printed EICHELMANN ALLEY, 20' at Conroy) ends at a lot line at y~1217; a 10 ft unnamed passage runs from there east to Renner (alleys). Mohawk Place (65', 62' at the bridge end) runs SW from McMicken and crosses the Miami Canal on MOHAWK BRIDGE to Central Av; the bridge is treated as part of Mohawk Place. The McMicken/Mohawk Place junction is a wide open area; the point is where the Mohawk Pl axis meets the McMicken centreline. The ~14 ft street leaving McMicken NNE at (5695,5035) is not named here; it is NAGEL ALLEY on sheet 229. Vernon/McMicken, Mohawk Place/McMicken, Nagel Alley/McMicken, Vernon/Mohawk and Vernon/Renner are also drawn (and picked) near the top of sheet 229, which is rotated relative to this sheet. Central Av (60') north frontage is continuous between Linn and the bridge; its SE leg runs between the 1921-1901 frontage and the canal to Bank and continues SSE off the sheet. Brown Alley (printed BROWN ALLEY, 20') runs east from Linn to x~3725, where two unnamed 10 ft alleys leave it, one NE to Central and one SSE to Bank (alleys). Klotter Av is only a stub in the blank west margin. Canal, tow path, railroad sidings in Central and Plum Street (the strip along the canal's NE bank east of the bridge, drawn on 229) are not recorded here.
